Chapter 6167: You Will Die

Chapter 6167: You Will Die

“Six-dao Heavenslay Formation.” A desolate god said: “Wait, the one from the legends?”

“It is real, Supreme Heaven used it during Heavenslay War.” An emperor said: “It’s been dormant all this time since no one had inflicted this much damage on Immortal Suppression Dynasty.”

The name was foreign to many listeners. Nevertheless, they appreciated being able to witness a legendary formation.

According to the tales, Supreme Heaven relied on it to kill numerous experts including emperors and primal ancestors. Yes, even primal ancestors fell to it.

“So this is the true foundation of Immortal Suppression Dynasty.” Everyone felt tiny compared to the immortal sword.

“Was it created by Dingtian? That’s what I’ve heard.” A big shot said.

“That I do not know, but its power is enough to kill primal ancestors.” An emperor said while staring at the sky.

“Transcendent Emperor is incredible, controlling the formation on his own. He can fight a primal ancestor in his current state.” Another said quietly.

The formation required six emperors of similar cultivation, which might explain why Golden Flower and Witch King joined the battle. However, they didn’t expect to be decimated before activating the formation.

Transcendent became the only one left to control the formation. Nevertheless, he still activated it - a testament to his wondrous skills and comprehension.

“It depends on the primal ancestor, there are levels to it.” An emperor said.

“Then what level is Li Qiye?” Someone couldn’t help but ask.

By this point, everyone believed he was above the emperors. Only a primal ancestor could defeat five apex emperors so easily.

“Talented indeed, makes me not want to kill you.” Li Qiye nodded approvingly.

“I do not deserve your praise for I was too blind to see Mount Tai. I underestimated you, Sir, my apologies.” Transcendent said sincerely.

He maintained his composure and a zen state, possessing no hatred or fear.

“You’re far from the first.” Li Qiye smiled.

“There is always someone superior, I’ve been too arrogant recently so this was a necessary wake-up call.” He sighed.

He was qualified to be arrogant due to his talent. Although Immortal Suppressor was currently stronger, he would surpass him in time. He also believed he would become the number one cultivator in Old World due to his unlimited potential.

Alas, Li Qiye shattered his dream today, making him realize that it was just a fantasy.

“Self-awareness is a wonderful thing. If you can be honest with yourself, your dao heart will grow stronger. You have enough potential for me to spare you, leave.” Li Qiye waved his hand.

Transcendent shook his head and said: “I appreciate your compassion and high evaluation, but I will stand here and not back down, not even a single step.”

Others took a deep breath after hearing this and felt confused. Time was the only thing he was missing. He could become a supreme overlord after surpassing the extinguishment.

“This formation can’t do anything to me. You will die if you block my path.” Li Qiye said casually.

“Your power is beyond our ability to measure. I know I can kill primal ancestors with this formation, but not you, Sir.” Transcendent took a deep breath and still didn’t budge.

“Yes, you will die.” Li Qiye repeated.

No one would mock him for leaving since he had already tried his best to defend the dynasty. It had never needed stalwart defenders before but now, it appeared to be on the brink of collapse due to Li Qiye.
